t: The Gravity of the Mean: AI, Code Regression, and Forensic Debugging
s: This article details the debugging process of an AI-assisted code refactor, highlighting the challenge of AI smoothing out custom logic and the creation of new mental models like 'Transparency Overlay' and 'Gravity of the Mean' for human-AI collaboration.
sub: Mental models for AI development (Transparency Overlay, Gravity of the Mean)
Forensic debugging and bug capture protocols
